about.valuesCommunityDesc: Every decision we make is guided by what's best for the Peenya and Nagasandra community — residents, students, and small business owners alike.
about.valuesTrustDesc: Vendors are verified. Reviews are genuine. We do not accept paid placements or fake ratings. What you see is what the community actually thinks.
about.valuesFreeDesc: Maitri is free for residents to use and free for small businesses to list. Supporting the local economy should never come with a paywall.
about.howSubtitle: Three easy steps to find — or be found by — the local community.
about.howStep1Desc: Residents search by service type, vendor name, or location in Peenya or Nagasandra. Filter by category. Sort by rating. Find in seconds.
about.howStep2Desc: Real reviews from real neighbours. Check ratings and read experiences before you visit. No fake reviews, no paid promotions.
about.howStep3Desc: Get directions, phone numbers, and opening hours. Visit your local vendor and support the people and businesses that make Peenya thrive.
about.catCoverDesc: We launched with the four categories most requested by residents in our community survey.
about.catFoodDesc: Tiffin centres, dosa stalls, juice corners, and evening snacks
about.catTailorsDesc: Blouses, alterations, custom stitching, and embroidery
about.catPrintingDesc: Document printing, lamination, visiting cards, and binding
about.catRepairDesc: Screen replacement, battery, data recovery, and servicing
about.catFuture: More categories — grocery, beauty, electronics, and more — are planned for future phases.
about.faq1A: Yes — completely free. Residents can browse, search, and review vendors without paying anything. Vendors can list their business at no charge.
about.faq2Q: How do I list my business?
about.faq2A: Click "List Your Business" anywhere on the site and fill in your details. Your listing will be reviewed by our team and approved within 24–48 hours.
about.faq3A: We manually review each vendor submission and verify the phone number and location before approval. Verified vendors receive a ✅ badge on their listing.
about.faq4A: Currently Peenya (1st, 2nd Stage, Industrial Area) and Nagasandra. We plan to expand to Jalahalli, Yeshwanthpur, and surrounding areas in future phases.
about.faq5Q: Can I report a wrong listing or a bad experience?
about.faq5A: Yes. A complaints and reporting system is available. You can raise a complaint directly on the vendor's page or write a review to inform other users.
about.ctaTitle: Ready to Join Your Local Community?
about.ctaSubtitle: Whether you're a resident looking for local services, or a business owner wanting to be discovered — Maitri is for you.
about.pageSubtitle: Built for Peenya and Nagasandra — a community platform with a local heart.
about.storySubtitle: Maitri (Sanskrit: मैत्री — friendship, goodwill) was born from a simple observation: the best local shops are often the hardest to find.
about.storyP1: Peenya is one of India's largest industrial areas. Nagasandra is a fast-growing residential neighbourhood. Together, they are home to thousands of factory workers, students, and families — all of whom rely on the same small cluster of local businesses every single day.
about.storyP2: Yet discovering a reliable dosa stall near Peenya Gate 2, a blouse tailor in Nagasandra, or a trustworthy phone repair shop used to mean asking a neighbour or hunting through WhatsApp groups. Maitri changes that.
about.problemDesc: Small neighbourhood businesses don't show up on giant national apps, making them invisible to new residents and students.
about.p1Desc: Local tailors, printers, and tiffin centers rarely have websites or social pages.
about.p2Desc: Finding good repair shops or breakfast spots takes months of asking around.
about.p3Desc: Students and workers new to Peenya struggle to find daily essentials nearby.
about.solutionTitle: A Platform Designed for the Neighbourhood
about.solutionDesc: Maitri connects local businesses directly with nearby customers through a clean, fast, zero-fee platform.
about.val1Desc: Focused 100% on Peenya and Nagasandra streets and landmarks.
about.val2Desc: Honest ratings and feedback from verified neighbours and students.
about.val3Desc: Completely free listing and direct communication with customers.
about.val4Desc: No commissions, no hidden charges, direct phone and chat connections.
